title: 4-Bit Adder / Subtractor Using Logic Gates
description: Add and subtract two 4-bit unsigned binary inputs using a mode switch and four Full Adder subcircuits built from XOR, AND and OR logic gates. Mode 0 adds A+B; Mode 1 computes A-B using two's complement. Toggle A0-A3, B0-B3 and Mode to observe S0-S3 and Cout. In subtraction mode, Cout=1 indicates no borrow. No built-in Adder/Subtractor is used.
